name: Girl
source:
She was [url=https://vndb.org/c73288]Yuu[/url]'s classmate last year and is in the same grade as him.

A once extremely shy girl, she gained confidence in herself after Yuu reached out to her. She now has a lot of friends but hasn't forgotten the boy who gave her a chance back then...
